name: Aibonito (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Four equal horizontal bands of blue, white, red and yellow, with a green isosceles triangle based on the hoist bearing the arms of the Villa de Aibonito.
history: Aibonito is a mountain town and municipality of Puerto Rico. According to Flags of the World the blue stands for the sky, the white for the purity of the air, the red for love of the motherland and the yellow for traditional Hispanic values.

features.role: arms of the Villa de Aibonito
